searches.query: "Exactly-Once Processing" interview Kafka external database transactions
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: Python 3.10 sqlite3: Connection context manager
sources.supportRationale: Primary documentation for the local Python 3.10 SQLite transaction model: successful context exit commits, exceptions roll back. No distributed or production concurrent guarantee is inferred.

sources.title: System Design Primer: Asynchronism, message queues, task queues and back pressure
sources.supportRationale: Required core conceptual/interview-study reference, inspected 2026-11-17; historical product comparisons are not adopted as current guarantees or evidence of question frequency.

sources.title: AWS Prescriptive Guidance: Transactional outbox
sources.supportRationale: Atomic local state/publication intent and remaining duplicate/consumer effect boundaries.

sources.title: Azure Architecture Center: Event Sourcing pattern
sources.supportRationale: Concurrency, snapshots, event evolution and projection rebuilding as separate design obligations.

sources.title: Kafka Java client 4.1.2: KafkaProducer
sources.supportRationale: Transactional producer lifecycle, error handling and coupling output with consumed positions; external effects are outside that atomic boundary.

sources.title: Kafka Java client 4.1.2: KafkaConsumer
sources.supportRationale: Position versus committed position, manual progress handling, rebalances, thread-safety and asynchronous processing caveats.

sources.title: Apache Kafka 4.1: Consumer configuration
sources.supportRationale: Classic group, poll/progress, isolation and bounded-fetch controls; protocol and settings are named rather than inferred from generic consumer terminology.

sources.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 Streams: Core concepts
sources.supportRationale: Partitioned stream processing, task/state and event-time concepts; not a guarantee of globally ordered external effects.

sources.title: Apache Kafka 4.1: Design and delivery semantics
sources.supportRationale: Partitioned storage, publication/consumption semantics and scoped transaction boundaries; examples explicitly target the 4.1 series rather than a latest-version claim.

sources.title: Amazon Builders’ Library: Timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter
sources.supportRationale: Unknown outcomes, retry amplification and bounded recovery; no universal timing constants are copied.

sources.title: Apache Kafka 4.1: Producer configuration
sources.supportRationale: Acknowledgment, idempotence, retries, transaction identity and ordering constraints under explicit settings.

scenarios.theme: A worker dies after a SQL credit but before acknowledgment. What makes recovery safe?
